title: Bind installed gateway OSCORE contexts to canonical peer IDs
description: Security review of the new runtime GCP dispatch found Gateway::install_gcp_context accepts an arbitrary Context for a pinned public key without validating the context's sender/recipient IDs or detecting seven-byte OSCORE-ID collisions. A caller could associate the wrong traffic keys/identity with a durable pin. Require canonical local/peer seven-byte IDs, reject colliding full IIDs, and test fail-closed installation.
